name: Hair shedding explained
description: Hair shedding explained in plain English: why hair often sheds 2 to 4 months after a big change in the body, how much hair shedding is normal (50 to 100 hairs a day), the hair growth cycle, telogen effluvium, shedding vs hair loss, how long a shed usually lasts and when to see a dermatologist.

name: Postpartum hair care
description: Postpartum hair care and postpartum hair loss, explained calmly: why shedding usually peaks about four months after birth, what is normal, when to see a dermatologist, gentle habits for new moms and a simple photo habit to track your hair. Most women see normal fullness return by the baby's first birthday.

name: Scalp care routine
description: Simple scalp care routines for a clean, comfortable scalp and fuller-looking hair: how to apply a scalp serum with the part method, a two-minute daily scalp massage, scalp care vs hair care and an edited scalp care shelf. Skincare thinking, for your scalp.

name: Hair care tips for women over 40
description: Hair care tips for women over 40 and 50: small daily habits for fuller-looking hair, habits to retire, low-effort routines for busy weeks and an honest way to judge your hair with part photos. Aging hair care, without the hype.

name: Hair care ingredients
description: Hair care ingredients explained in plain English: rosemary for hair, peptides, eucalyptus, saw palmetto and other plant extracts. How to read a scalp serum label, fragrance-free vs unscented, and what free-from claims really mean.

name: Healthy hair habits
description: Healthy hair tips and habits that protect the hair you have: how to brush shedding hair without breakage, gentler heat styling settings for fine hair and small everyday swaps for fuller-looking hair.

name: Hair progress photos
description: How to take hair progress photos you can trust: photograph your part the same way at week 0, week 6 and week 12. Four rules for a fair comparison, a simple 90-day hair routine check-in, and why photos beat the mirror.

name: Aftergrow Scalp Serum
description: Aftergrow Scalp Serum: a lightweight, water-based, fragrance-free peptide scalp serum for fuller-looking hair. A few drops along the part, once a day, no rinsing. Every ingredient explained, plus the 90-Day Protocol.
